Commentary.Commentary: So, that's it from this nerve-wracking game where Bangladesh hold onto their nerves and seal the series 2-0 with a game left. That game will be played on Friday, 6th March 2020 in Sylhet. The match will begin at 1400 local (0800 GMT). We will love your company for that game. Till then, it is goodbye from our side.

Tamim Iqbal is named Man of the Match for his brilliant century. Iqbal says that credit for his performance goes to the team management as they kept trusting him and told him that it will come good soon. Tells that the wicket was really good for batting but in the second innings, it became even better. Feels that he got a few bad balls on his pads and scored a few boundaries early on. Praises Liton Das and Najmul Hossain Shanto and Mahmudullah for their performance.

Mashrafe Mortaza, Bangladesh skipper, says that they held onto their nerves to win the game. On brilliant ton of Tamim, Mortaza says that he is a special player. Tells that he was really happy seeing him bat the way he did. Praises the performance from Rahim and Mahmudullah 's performance. On their bowling, the Bangladeshi skipper feels that the wicket was really good for batting. Adds that bowling was difficult but it was not too bad. Points that winning close games like these gives a lot of experience to the players.

Sean Williams, Zimbabwe skipper, says that after coming from a defeat in the 1st ODI and almost winning this game is really positive and they will try to win the last one. Feels that the youngsters took the responsibility and almost delivered for the side. Praises Raza for his valuable knock. Also feels that Madhevere was brilliant and adds that he is a great find for Zimbabwe cricket. Tells that Tiripano is really disappointed in the change room but feels that he should hold his head high and walk with a smile. Feels that injuries are part and parcel of the game and the teammates are always there for each other.

Earlier in the day, Bangladesh ended with a huge total of 322/8, courtesy of a special knock from Tamim Iqbal. His 158 along with supports from Mushfiqur Rahim, Mahmudullah and Mohammad Mithun helped them amass the total. It was a tough day for the bowlers in general and the Zimbabwe bowlers suffered too. Carl Mumba and Donald Tiripano grabbed two wickets each but were expensive in their efforts. Stay tuned for the presentation...

Bangladesh almost shot themselves on the foot with the ball but managed to survive a big upset. The bowlers started off well and were good in the middle too but they were not able to pick up wickets. They lost the plot towards the end and almost snatched defeat from the jaws of victory. Shafiul Islam and the returning Al-Amin Hossain had a nightmare towards the end. Though the latter managed to hold his nerves in the final over, he had a torrid time and went for 85 in his 10 overs. Shafiul Islam, on the other hand, conceded 76 from 9 overs. Taijul Islam was the star with the ball as he ended up with a 3-wicket haul. The win was made difficult by the fielders as the hosts were sloppy in the field and dropped plenty of chances that almost came back to bite them. In the end, the home team held their nerves and got over the finish line.

Chasing 323, Zimbabwe lost Regis Chakabva and Brendan Taylor early. Tinashe Kamunhukamwe though kept his end intact and built partnerships. The tourists were lagging behind the required run rate but fifties from Tinashe Kamunhukamwe, Wesley Madhevere and Sikandar Raza gave them hope and kept them in the hunt but when they lost Raza they had just 3 wickets in hand and still needed 98 in 43. It looked done and dusted but Donald Tiripano had other ideas. He came out with intent and went berserk. He put up a quickfire stand of 80 off just 45 balls with Mutombodzi. They dragged the game till the last ball but Tiripano's heroics was not enough to get his side over the line.

WOW! What a game of cricket we have witnessed! They say it is not over until it's over and Zimbabwe just proved that. They couldn't get over the line but they sent chills across Bangladesh with their spirited fight. A great, great innings with the bat from Donald Tiripano. Yes, he ends up on the wrong side of the result but he has shown the passion, the courage and the desire that these Zimbabwe players had.

Just a single! Al-Amin keeps his nerves and seals the game and series for his side. A full ball just outside off, it is in the slot but Tiripano is backing away a bit and all he can do is drive it to long off for a run. BANGLADESH WIN BY 4 runs.

On a good length on off, Williams defends it off the back foot.
Length delivery on off, Williams plays it towards point.
Full delivery on middle, Kamunhukamwe flicks it through square leg for a single.
On a length on off, Williams punches it through covers for a run.
Length delivery on off, Kamunhukamwe punches it through covers for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, Williams looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads. Just 1 run from the over.
Flighted delivery on off, Williams plays it to covers.
Tossed up delivery on off, Williams punches it to point.
Floated delivery on middle, Tinashe flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, Kamunhukamwe flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Kamunhukamwe pushes it back towards the bowler.
Good length ball around off, Williams pushes it towards mid off.
Full and on the pads, Williams strokes it straight to mid on.
On the pads again, Kamunhukamwe tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Length ball on the pads, Williams clips it towards square leg for a run.
Short and outside off, Williams cuts it well but the point fielder dives to his left and stops the ball.
A length ball on middle, Kamunhukamwe tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes a run.
FOUR! Just guided it! Quicker one and outside off, Williams waits for the ball and then guides it past short third man for a boundary.
Fuller and around off, pushed towards point.
Quicker one on middle, worked wide of the man at mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker one on middle, Kamunhukamwe keeps it out.
Shortish and on middle, Kamunhukamwe hangs on the back foot to keep it out.
Floated on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Mehidy Hasan to bowl now. He has already affected a brilliant run out. What can he do with the ball?
Full and just outside off, it is stroked to mid off.
Good length ball around off, pushed to point.
Beaten! Good length ball just outside off, Williams looks to force it to the off side but misses.
Good length ball angled into the batter, Williams taps it back to the bowler.
Good length ball outside off, left alone.
Full and around off, Kamunhukamwe lifts it over the bowler for a single as the man from long on comes for the mopping up job. 50 up for Zimbabwe.
Powerplay 2 time! Maximum of 4 fielders can be outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.

FOUR! Nicely played! Length delivery on off, Williams punches it through covers for a boundary. That is the end of Powerplay 1. The tourists are 49/2 while Bangladesh were 65/1 at this stage. 274 needed more off 240 balls now.
On a length on middle, Kamunhukamwe flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Shafiul Islam bowls a bouncer, Kamunhukamwe looks to pull but misses it.
Skipper Sean Williams walks in next with his side in trouble.

OUT! Run Out! Excellent piece of work from Mehidy Hasan and a little bit of casual running from Brendan Taylor. Maybe Shafiul came in his way but that cannot be an excuse. Don't take anything away from that superb Mehidy Hasan. Fuller on off, Taylor nudges it to the left of mid-wicket. Mehidy runs to his left, gathers the ball with his left and scores a direct hit with his right all this while going down. He has one stump to aim and he hits it to perfection. Brendan Taylor is well short of his crease and the umpire does not even have to go upstairs for it. The Bangladesh players are ecstatic and so are the fans. Taylor was timing the ball well but his innings has been cut short. The tough chase has just been made tougher by the loss of Brendan Taylor.
On a good length on off, Taylor defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! Nobody moved! Full on off, Taylor gets on his front foot and lofts it brilliantly over the bowler's head. Nobody moved and everybody are awestruck by that glorious shot.
Full delivery on off, Kamunhukamwe drives it to covers. 10 runs from the over.
Good length ball around off, Kamunhukamwe keeps it out.

Dropped! A tough chance though! Short and wide outside off, Kamunhukamwe cuts it hard towards point. Hossain Shanto dives to his right, gets his hands to it but fails to hold on. The ball goes to the fence.
SIX! Going, going, gone! Kamunhukamwe finally breaks free. A back of a length ball down the leg side, Kamunhukamwe rocks on the back foot and slams it over deep square leg for a maximum.
Fuller and around off, this time Kamunhukamwe pushes it to mid on.
Good length ball on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Short and outside off, Taylor punches it well but finds cover-point.
Full and just outside off, pushed towards covers.
Shortish and around off, Taylor taps it back to the bowler.
Full delivery outside off, Taylor drives it to covers.
Good length delivery on off, Taylor defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! That is whipped away! Length delivery on middle, Taylor flicks it through square leg for a boundary. This boundary should break the shackles.

Quick single! The dots were building pressure and that made Taylor go for a risky run. A fuller ball around off, Taylor pushes it to mid off and takes off. The fielder from mid off picks the ball and fires the throw at the non-striker's end but misses. The replays show that had the fielder hit the stumps, Taylor would've been heading home.
Full and outside off, Taylor drives but finds covers again. 9 dots in a row for Taylor.
Good length ball around off, Taylor once again pushes it towards covers.
Fuller and around off, Taylor is solid in his defense.
Short and outside off, stroked through point for a run.
Play and a miss! A length ball outside off, Kamunhukamwe looks to cut but misses.
A dot to finish! Good length ball around off, Taylor comes forward once again to defend it out.
Another length ball around off, Taylor comes forward and keeps it out.
Landed around off, Taylor comes forward and keeps it out.
Full and on middle, Taylor flicks it well but finds mid-wicket.
Good length ball just outside off, Kamunhukamwe looks to drive but the ball takes the outside edge and rolls to third man for a run.
Short delivery on middle, Kamunhukamwe pulls it to mid-wicket.
On a good length on middle, Taylor keeps it out.
Good length delivery on off, Taylor defends it off the back foot.
On a length on middle, Tinashe flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery on off, Kamunhukamwe punches it towards point.
On a good length on off, Kamunhukamwe defends it off the front foot.
Full delivery outside off, Taylor drives it towards covers where Tamim Iqbal makes a diving stop to his left. The batsmen take a single.

FOUR! Excellent shot from Kamunhukamwe. He has looked very good so far. Length delivery outside off, Kamunhukamwe gets on his back foot like he was expecting it and then he punches it superbly through covers for a boundary.
Shortish and just outside off, Kamunhukamwe punches it well but straight to covers.
Landed around off, pushed back to the bowler.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Kamunhukamwe looks to flick but misses. Wided by the umpire.
Play and a miss! A length ball outside off, Kamunhukamwe looks to drive on the up but he misses.
Taylor is off the mark quickly. A length ball around off, Taylor pushes it towards mid on and takes a quick run.
Brendan Taylor is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Shafiul strikes early. Chakabva is the man who departs. A length ball on middle, Chakabva looks to work it on the leg side but closes the bat face a little too early. The ball takes the leading edge. It lobs to Liton Das at cover-point who accepts the catch gleefully.
Landed around off, pushed to mid on.
Shortish and on middle, Chakabva tucks it behind square leg for a single.
Length ball around off, worked towards square leg for a run.
Good length ball around off, blocked back to the bowler.
FOUR! Up and over! Full and outside off,  Kamunhukamwe just lofts it over extra cover for a boundary.
Tap and run! A length ball around off, Chakabva tucks it towards mid on and takes a quick run to get off the mark.
Another ball angled into the pads, Kamunhukamwe once again misses his flick as the ball hits him high on the pads and rolls towards mid-wicket.
Shortish and around off, pushed towards point.
FOUR! Smashed down the ground! A fuller length ball around off, Kamunhukamwe just hammers it down the ground and the ball races away to the fence. First boundary of the innings.
Landed on a length on middle, worked towards mid-wicket.
WIDE! Down the leg side now. Kamunhukamwe looks to flick but misses again. Wided by the umpire.
On the pads again, Chakabva misses his flick again. The ball hits the pads and rolls to fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Mild appeal on the first ball from Shafiul Islam. A length ball angled into the batter. Chakabva looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal follows but nothing from the umpire.
Shafiul Islam to bowl from the other end.

Off the mark on the last ball with a quick couple. A length ball on the pads, Kamunhukamwe tucks it behind square leg and calls for a couple. The fielder picks the ball and throws it to the keeper who tries to run Kamunhukamwe out with a no-look effort but misses. Tight first over from the Bangladesh skipper.
On the pads this time, Kamunhukamwe flicks it well but finds mid-wicket.
Length ball around off, worked towards mid-wicket.
Shortish and around off, Kamunhukamwe punches it towards cover-point.
Good length ball around off, Kamunhukamwe tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Mortaza starts with a length ball outside off, Kamunhukamwe lets it go to the keeper.

We are back for the chase. The Bangladesh players are out in the middle. Tinashe Kamunhukamwe and Regis Chakabva will open the innings for Zimbabwe. Mashrafe Mortaza will start the proceedings for the hosts.
